    - FINAL FANTASY EXPLORERS FORCE, Action, version 1.6.1 of 2018-11-29 (a free gacha crystal reward per cleared chapter), 4,866 ratings (2.9 stars), 100,000+ installs, Android 4.4 or later, rated 13+, in-app purchases; a role-based multiplayer action RPG with jobs, avatar creation, a battle arena, and transformation into series heroes through magic stones
    - The captures of 2021 to 2023 are after the service ended
- https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/final-fantasy-explorers-force/id1161393372 -- the iOS row -- accessed 2026-10-20

  - The capture of 2025-07-12 (https://web.archive.org/web/20250712010108/https://apps.apple.com/us/app/final-fantasy-explorers-force/id1161393372?l=ja&ls=1, found by the user) only shows a loading spinner; its HTML holds no page content ("App Storeに接続しています"), so it cannot show the app
  - The capture of 2019-07-26 (https://apps.apple.com/jp/app/id1161393372) shows 9,389 ratings and reviews that predict the service's end
